verdict.rationale: Devin's docs describe tagging Devin in a Slack or Teams thread about a bug you're discussing with coworkers, and starting sessions straight from those conversations about bugs, feature requests or questions. That covers both discussing and delegating from a chat thread. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how the in-thread back-and-forth works (replies, status updates, follow-up instructions), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the Slack/Teams flow.
